description: This file defines the Challenge entity class for a Java-based application using JPA annotations. It maps to a 'challenges' table in a database, with fields such as id, user, challenge type, challenge data, timestamps, IP address, and user agent. It includes JPA annotations for ORM, index definitions, and a pre-persist method to initialize certain fields before saving.

classes.name: Challenge
classes.description: JPA entity class representing a challenge record in the database, including fields for challenge details, timestamps, and user association.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback method executed before the entity is persisted, generating UUID and setting creation timestamp if not already set.
